chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 526: The Xingtian Spirit vs. the White-Faced Jiao
chapter_meta_description: The Great Xia war machine reaches the Seamless City. A Xingtian divine spirit and an ancient凶兽 face off in a lake. The war arc begins.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 526 – A Headless Colossus Faces an Ancient Beast
og_description: The first clash of the war: the Xingtian Grand Formation versus the White-Faced Jiao. Ji Ning watches as the Great Xia and the Seamless Gate deploy mythic war engines.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 526: The War Arc Begins
twitter_description: A headless Fiendgod and a serpent-tailed凶兽 prepare to clash. The scale has officially shifted from genius to war engine.

lore_anchors.definition: In ancient Chinese mythology, Xingtian is a beheaded Fiendgod who fought the Yellow Emperor. After losing his head, he grew eyes on his chest and a mouth on his navel, continuing to fight with shield and axe. In Desolate Era, the Xingtian Grand Formation manifests a divine spirit modeled after this undying war-god.
A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals as a foundation and 1,000 Celestial Immortals as a framework, manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability.
An ancient凶兽 (savage beast) born with the combat power of an Empyrean God. It features a white human face, a body covered in black scales, and a dragon-serpent tail over thirty thousand zhang long.
A major power of the Seamless Gate, knowledgeable about the Great Xia’s nine generals. She proposes testing the Xingtian spirit's strength with the White-Faced Jiao.
The commander of the Seamless City forces. He calmly surveys the approaching Xingtian spirit and orchestrates the defensive response.
The most powerful faction on Nuwa’s side during the primordial age, even stronger than the Daoist and Buddhist sects. The Xia Emperor is a descendant of this clan.
One of the five Empyrean Gods and True Immortals by the Xia Emperor’s side, present in the command hall to observe the opening clash.
Progenitor of the Tiannong clan, one of the five major powers by the Xia Emperor’s side. He notes that the battle feels like a return to the primordial age.
An incredibly hard material mined from the endless Chaos by True God Daofathers. Only Empyrean God / True Immortal level strength can shatter it. The Xingtian spirit was previously tested against it.
